Braixen

Fire

Kalos · Generation 6

Braixen is a Fire-type Fox Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 14.5 kg. It evolves from Fennekin and into Delphox. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (90), with a base stat total of 409.
